svg.text: How it all connects — Student Management System
Python stdlib HTTP server · MySQL · C++ compute engine · zero frameworks
ROUTE MODULES — every URL in the app (shared plumbing: validation.py · template.py)
backend/models/ — every SQL query lives here (parameterized, one fresh connection per call)
links + form posts · receives HTML + CSS
writes Response back to the socket
db.py — connection factory (opens, commits, closes per call)
subprocess bridge · 30 s timeout · TSV in / out
src: sms_engine.cpp — modes: grades · attendance · rank
rendered by routes/template.py with model data
scripts/setup_db.py — creates DB + sms_app user, applies schema.sql & seed.sql
solid = request / data flow dashed = setup · engine wire
